No other section 6 or 7 byte was added.

The acceptance session did get profile A (Small at position 529) and, after the pose change, profile B (C1 at position 540, dimensions 5 by 7). The menu then returned to shooting without an S-NVRAM save, so the run ended `ok:false` before the reopen press and release. That was the sixth experiment version, so no further runner was started.
